sections.title: North Carolina corporate income and franchise taxes

rows.label: Corporate income tax rate
rows.note: Flat rate for tax year 2026, down from 2.25% in 2025 under the scheduled phase-down.

rows.label: Franchise tax rate (C corporations)
rows.value: $1.50 per $1,000 of tax base, maximum $500 on the first $1,000,000 of tax base
rows.note: Franchise tax is reported on the corporate return alongside income tax.

rows.note: The bill uses the combined county and municipal/district rate per $100 of appraised value.

sections.title: North Carolina real estate transfer tax

rows.label: Excise tax on real estate conveyances
rows.value: $1 per $500 (or fraction) of the consideration or value conveyed
rows.note: State excise (revenue stamp) tax under G.S. Chapter 105, Article 8E. Source is an NCDOR statistical abstract table (FY 2014-15 edition).

source.title: NCDOR Statistical Abstract: Table 51, Excise [Stamp] Tax on Conveyances (PDF)

rows.label: Who pays the excise tax
rows.value: Transferor (seller), paid to the county register of deeds before recording
rows.note: Half of the proceeds stay with the county; the rest goes to the state.
